attributes.name: sidebar_presence_and_position
attributes.definition: Whether the page has a sidebar and on which side of the main content it sits.

values.definition: Sidebar placed to the right of main content.
Sidebar present, beside the main content, side not stated or left/other.

attributes.name: sidebar_container_treatment
attributes.definition: How the sidebar content is packaged visually.

values.definition: Sidebar broken into distinct rounded/card blocks.
Sidebar is one continuous panel or column.

attributes.name: main_content_container
attributes.definition: How the main content area is contained.

values.definition: Main content in one centered card surrounded by background margins.
Content arranged as multiple card columns.
A wide main column not described as a card.

attributes.name: main_to_sidebar_width_ratio
attributes.definition: Relative widths of main column versus sidebar.

values.definition: Main column wide, sidebar clearly narrower.
